index.meta.title: GOOD Growth — from a goal to finished posts
index.aria.illustration: Illustration: a post with an image
index.h1: From a goal to finished posts. In one evening.
index.lede: GOOD Growth is a quiet tool for small businesses and makers. Describe what you do — it turns the goal into a strategy, writes the posts and draws the images for them. All that's left is to press Publish.
index.cta.title: Ready to talk about your work?
index.cta.text: The first review is free. Signing up takes half a minute. After that, you decide.
index.note: Free. Sign-up in 30 seconds — and your first post in 10 minutes.
index.mock.title: “Velodelo” workshop
index.problem.title: A familiar ache
index.problem.text: You do the work in the evening, and there is no strength left for texts and images. An empty channel brings no clients, and a copywriter plus a designer means budget and explanations. So the page stays silent and the business lives on word of mouth alone.
index.solution.title: What GOOD Growth does
index.solution.text: One screen instead of five services. You answer five short questions about your work — the system does the rest.
index.card1.h: A strategy out of the goal
index.card1.p: Breaks “what, where, for whom” into audience, topics and channels — a clear plan instead of a blank page.
index.card2.p: Finished texts with headlines and illustrations in seconds. Edit as you like — it is a draft, not a cage.
index.card3.p: The Publish button sends the post to your channel. No copying, no extra windows.
index.how.title: How it works
index.step1.p: Five questions or one sentence — whatever suits you. Voice works too.
index.step2.p: Audience, topics, channels and posting rhythm — right on the screen.
index.step3.p: One, three, five or ten — with an image for each.
index.step4.p: Checked the headline — pressed the button — the post is in the channel.
index.benefits.title: Why it works
index.ben1.p: Everything is stored on our server for your account only, and we never sell it. No cloud dossiers.
index.ben2.p: An image takes about 15 seconds, a strategy about half a minute. The idea never has time to cool down.
index.ben3.p: No “first month free, then we charge you”. You pay only for what you actually use.

info.meta.title: For partners — GOOD Growth
info.h1: Earn by running the growth of other people's brands
info.lead: Agencies, freelancers and brand managers run 5–20 clients. GOOD Growth takes the routine: strategy, posts, images, publishing. You grow and you earn. Three models — pick yours.
info.m1.p: You pay a fixed subscription and run as many brands as you like. You charge clients your own price — the difference is yours.
info.fit.label: Fits:
info.m2.p: The tool is free. We take a share of every client you bring for as long as they use it. You pay nothing upfront.
info.m3.p: Your logo, your domain, your interface — clients never learn about us. Revenue split by contract.
info.m3.fit.c: with their own brand and 10+ clients.
info.s1.t: One letter to hello@growth.go-ood.com: who you are, how many clients, which model interests you.
info.s2.t: We open partner mode and help you move your first clients in — in one evening.
info.s3.t: Analytics per brand, a team with roles, publishing to their channels. Your income moves at your pace.
info.cta.title: Ready to talk?
info.cta.lead: The partner programme is opening — first places are discussed individually, around your client mix.
info.cta.note: And the workshop already works — you can show clients right now.
info.faq.title: Frequent questions
info.faq.a1: Technically yes: the brand list, switching, separate channels and analytics all work. Team roles and white-label are in their final stage. Commercial terms are discussed individually with the first partners.
info.faq.a2: Clients see only the result: posts in their channel. The interface, the GOOD Growth brand and the prices stay yours (in white-label — entirely yours).
info.faq.a3: Everything is stored on our server, isolated per brand. Keys and the database never leave GOOD Growth infrastructure, and backups are made regularly.
info.faq.q4: Can I start with commission and move to a subscription?
info.faq.a4: Yes, the model changes at any moment by agreement — the statistics collected for clients are kept.

team.note: Roles work: a Creator doesn't see Publish, an Approver approves drafts, a Publisher publishes. The role is tied to the helper's account by email (the owner without an email in the team has full rights). Invitation: the helper opens the link, sets a password — the account exists and the role is already theirs. While the mail ports are closed by the host, a copy of the letter comes to the owner in Telegram.
